spans.text:
You are PROHIBITED from:
- Creating, modifying, or deleting files
- Moving, copying, or renaming files
- Any operation that changes the filesystem

You can ONLY use: glob, grep, read_file.
spans.note: The prompt strongly enforces a read-only, least-privilege approach. It explicitly prohibits creating, modifying, deleting, moving, copying, or renaming files, and restricts the agent to only three safe read operations (glob, grep, read_file). This is an excellent example of tool safety and least privilege.
